name: RC-B10-0068/2026 – Motion for a resolution
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the conviction and imminent sentencing of Jimmy Lai in Hong Kong
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion. It condemns the conviction of Jimmy Lai, a British pro-democracy activist, in Hong Kong, and calls for his release and that of others held for using their freedoms. It also asks Hong Kong to drop the charges and give him medical care, and asks the European Union to take steps against Hong Kong and Chinese officials.

- Nothing changes yet: the Parliament only asks Hong Kong to free Jimmy Lai and drop the charges.
- It affects Jimmy Lai, other detained activists, and Hong Kong and Chinese officials the Parliament wants sanctioned.
- Next, the Parliament sends its request to the EU Commission and Council, China and Hong Kong.
